decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program sits close to the core offer and stayed visible in both years, so it meets the service aspiration at low cost, and the firm's slack in a growing industry gives no reason for problemistic search.
The seventy-two-hour program is costlier to run and overlaps with the broader express offer, but it stayed on the website and supports the firm's fast-response positioning, so it is likely kept.
The express delivery program for doors and gates kept a page of its own in both years, which signals a sustained commitment that seems to meet aspirations and should be kept.
The online ordering platform is strategic digital infrastructure for trade partners with its own page in both years, so the firm will carry it even while results are uncertain.
The fire and smoke protection door was upgraded to a page of its own in 2024 and appears to have replaced the withdrawn fire-resistant door, which suggests it performs above aspiration.
